mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO tool_execution_records (task_uuid, user_id, tool_name, idempotency_key, argument_fingerprint, status, started_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{taskUuid}, #{userId}, #{toolName}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{argumentFingerprint}, 'RUNNING', NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT task_uuid, user_id, tool_name, idempotency_key, argument_fingerprint, status, result_json, error_message, started_at, completed_at, updated_at FROM tool_execution_records WHERE task_uuid = #{taskUuid} AND idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE tool_execution_records SET status = #{status}, result_json = #{resultJson}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, updated_at = NOW(), completed_at = CASE WHEN #{status} IN ('SUCCEEDED', 'FAILED', 'UNKNOWN') THEN NOW() ELSE completed_at END WHERE task_uuid = #{taskUuid} AND idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey}
